title: Terms of use
subtitle: Tickets, bookings and payments
bodyMarkdown:
## Tickets and bookings

A ticket or booking is valid for the date and time shown. Tickets are personal to the bearer and may be scanned once per entry.

## Payments

Online payments are processed by our payment partner. Prices are in Nigerian Naira (NGN).

## Cancellations

Cancellations and rescheduling follow the policy shown on your booking at the time of purchase.

## Privacy

We store the details you give us to run your booking and, only if you opt in, to send news and offers. You can unsubscribe at any time.

*This is demo text for the development environment and must be replaced with your approved terms before launch.*
